featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a masterclass in how to turn a simple X-ray into a 24-hour suspense thriller, then Shahbazkers Diagnostic Centre Pvt Ltd in Mumbai truly delivers.

My mother had a fall and was advised an X-ray for her wrist and hip. We were confidently told the reports would be ready by 5:00 pm and conveniently shared on WhatsApp. Efficient, right? Well… not quite.

After three polite follow-ups, each met with the reassuringly vague “it’s not ready yet, we’ll update you,” we finally received the reports the next day. Apparently, the doctor needed to review them—and unfortunately, wasn’t available. Because, of course, nothing says urgency like a diagnostic delay when a patient is waiting to begin treatment.

Thankfully, the reports turned out normal. But one can’t help wondering—what if they weren’t? Are patients expected to pause their recovery plans while the system catches up?

All said and done, if promptness, communication, and basic coordination are on your checklist, you might want to keep exploring your options. If not, and you enjoy a bit of unpredictability with your healthcare experience, this place might just surprise you—in more ways than one.
